ADDENDUM (Decree Partially Amending the Enforcement Decree of the Lifelong Education Act, etc. to Reorganize Committees under Administrative Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 21087, October 20, 2008>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted.>

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.
